name: Set friendly name by template
description: Copy column friendly names from another transformation
statement:
/*
Copy column friendly names from another transformation
*/

UPDATE
	C1
SET
	FriendlyName = C.FriendlyName,
	ToOLAP = C.ToOLAP
FROM
	[CFG].[TRANSFORMATIONS] TR
	INNER JOIN CFG.COLUMNS C ON
		C.TableID = TR.TableID
	INNER JOIN [CFG].[TRANSFORMATIONS] TR1 ON
		TR1.TransformationID = :1
	INNER JOIN CFG.COLUMNS C1 ON
		C1.TableID = TR1.TableID AND
		C1.Column_Name = C.Column_Name
WHERE
	TR.[TransformationID] = :2
